text: In special relativity, two events are spacelike separated if and only if:
choices: There exists a reference frame in which they are simultaneous
A light signal can connect them
They share the same time coordinate in all frames
Their spatial separation equals their temporal separation
explanation: Spacelike separation means the spacetime interval s^2 = -(ct)^2 + (Δx)^2 > 0 (in the +--- signature). For any two spacelike-separated events, there always exists an inertial frame in which they are simultaneous (Δt = 0 in that frame). No causal signal can connect spacelike-separated events — the light cone does not connect them. This is the criterion for relativistic simultaneity being frame-dependent.
